name: Voxel Map Lookup
definition: Retrieves the color of a voxel at (x,y,z) by checking bounds, a global geometry bitfield, and a binary search within the corresponding chunk.
summary: Voxel Map Lookup retrieves exact voxel colors in sparse maps using a geometry bitfield and binary search, differing from related methods by enabling random access rather than serialization or surface-only retrieval.
